test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which state was the host of the fifth Khelo India Youth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The fifth Khelo India Youth Games 2022** took place in **Madhya Pradesh** and ended on **February 11, 2023**.
 
• Eight cities in the state, including Bhopal and Jabalpur, hosted the games.
 
• With 161 medals, including 56 gold, Maharashtra led the medal tally after the Games, followed by Madhya Pradesh and Haryana.
 
• Madhya Pradesh hosted the Games from January 31, 2023, to February 11, 2023.
 
• This edition of the Khelo India Games included water sports such kayaking, canoeing, canoe saladm, and fencing for the first time.
 
• It took place in eight different state cities. Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, Ujjain, Maheshwar, Mandla, and Balaghat are the eight host cities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG)** are an annual national multidisciplinary grassroots games for schoolchildren under the age of seventeen and college students under the age of twenty-one that are held in January or February in India.
 
• To prepare them for international sporting contests, the top 1,000 children would get an annual scholarship of ₹5 lakh (US$6,300) for eight years.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi officially opened the Khelo India School Games on January 31, 2018, at the Indira Gandhi Arena with a ceremony modeled by the Guru-shishya tradition.
 
• After the Indian Olympic Association joined earlier in September 2018, the Khelo India School Games were renamed to Khelo India Youth Games for the 2019 games.
